name: Amaya Dorman
source:
Fortune-teller who owns a shop in downtown that opens at evenings. At first glance she appears to be a polite and friendly woman, but she is actually rude. 
Amaya is also a master of Oriental Hojutsu charging, making amulets, exorcism and demons.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=2784]Getchu[/url].]
